thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Multiple private-connectivity checks failing in us-west-3 (usw3). Elevated latency, DNS timeouts for PrivateLink endpoints. Auto-pager sent to oncall.
sam-net: I'm on it. Paging net oncall.
pagerduty: PagerDuty alert triggered for sam-net (oncall). Priority: P1
sam-net: quick summary — customers reporting 502s to privatelink endpoints + some internal services showing TCP RSTs. Happening across us-west-3a and 3b. Suspect route propagation / AZ control plane.
jen-sre: seeing increased SLO errors on the dashboard. Frontend graph shows spike at 14:03 UTC.
maria-support: multiple customer tickets. I'll draft an initial status update once we know scope.
sam-net: running quick checks — checking route tables and peering state.
sam-net: run: ```aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=redwood-privatelink-usw3 --query 'RouteTables[*].Routes'``` seeing some routes in pending/blackhole state.
jen-sre: digging into connectivity tests — doing dig against privatelink dns:
jen-sre: ```dig @10.10.8.2 priv-endpoint.customer.internal +short``` returns nothing / times out.
sam-net: also seeing BGP neighborship flaps with provider VRF for the affected AZ. Logs show repeated BGP NOTIFICATION then RESET.
cloud-status-bot: Cloud provider status page: "Networking incident affecting routing in us-west-3 AZ-B and AZ-C, under investigation." link: https://status.cloudprovider.example/incidents/12345
sam-net: confirmed provider is showing an internal fabric issue in AZ-B/C. This is likely causing route-programming issues to our PrivateLink appliances.
maria-support: I posted to customers: "Investigating network issues impacting private connectivity in us-west-3. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation. Will update in 30m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jen-sre: mitigation plan proposal:
- fail traffic to public-hosted endpoints for impacted customers (temporary)
- update routing policy in Control Plane to point client fallback to public endpoints
- enable cached responses in edge for non-sensitive routes
sam-net: +1. I'll prepare the control-plane change. Need to coordinate with infra to ensure no config drift.
sam-net: command to back out route propagation (dry run):
sam-net: ```
# mark PrivateLink endpoints as unreachable to force fallback
redwoodctl config set routing.usw3.privatelink.behavior 'prefer_public_on_failure' --dry-run
```
jen-sre: testing failover path for one test customer now.
jen-sre: test shows HTTP 200 to public endpoint when we flip the flag, latency ~120ms, acceptable for short term. DNS still flaky for private names though.
maria-support: are there customers with strict private-only requirements? We should not auto-fail them.
sam-net: good catch. We'll only flip for customers marked "allow_public_fallback" in tenant config. Doing a canary for 3 tenants first.
sam-net: applying change for tenants: tenant-42, tenant-77, tenant-omega
sam-net: ```redwoodctl routing update --tenant tenant-42 --privatelink-fallback public --region usw3``` -> applied
jen-sre: canary looks good: no 502s for those tenants after 2 mins. Rolling to next 20 tenants.
jen-sre: monitoring for increased latency or auth errors.
cloud-status-bot: update: provider says "mitigation in progress: control plane reprogramming" ETA unknown.
maria-support: sent updated message to customers: "We've enabled a temporary public fallback for eligible tenants. If you require private-only connectivity, reply and we'll coordinate." :envelope_with_arrow:
sam-net: also pushing a BGP soft-reset to our VRF peers to try to re-establish stable adjacencies. Command: ```bgpctl neighbor X.X.X.X soft-reconfig in``` — doing now.
sam-net: observed BGP flaps stopping on one aggregator after reset. Some routes reprogrammed; route tables show fewer blackholed entries.
jen-sre: running synthetic checks across full tenant set — errors dropping from 18% -> 3% for those we rolled. Overall still at 7% due to remaining AZs.
sam-net: contacting cloud provider NOC directly via escalation channel to get targeted remediation for AZ-C fabric.
cloud-status-bot: provider update: "Partial restoration observed; fabric control plane fix deployed to AZ-B. Working on AZ-C now."
jen-sre: let's schedule a full rollback plan: if provider fix doesn't stabilize in 45m, we'll keep public fallback on and open a SEV-2 (customer-impact) for extended mitigation.
maria-support: drafting a Status Page update and a Slack customer post. Will include list of impacted tenants and our mitigation steps. Ping me if you want direct quotes.
sam-net: handing to day oncall for followup. @jen-sre please continue monitoring and coordinate with provider. I'll stay reachable for escalation.
jen-sre: taking over. I'll post updates every 15m. Current action items:
- confirm provider fix in AZ-C
- gradually roll back public-fallback for tenants as routes stabilize
- collect packet captures and logs for postmortem
- coordinate customer comms with Maria
jen-sre: quick note — capturing tcpdump from privatelnk appliance: ```sudo tcpdump -nni eth0 host 10.10.8.2 and port 53 -w /tmp/dns-flap.pcap``` saved.
maria-support: shared initial customer message on status page. A few replies asking for ETA and SLA credits.
jen-sre: provider posted final update: "Control plane patched in AZ-C; route propagation resuming." I'll start teasing back private routes for canary tenants.
jen-sre: backout command for fallback:
jen-sre: ```redwoodctl routing update --tenant tenant-42 --privatelink-fallback private --region usw3``` -> applied, validation ok.
jen-sre: rolling back for remaining tenants in waves, monitoring DNS and TCP resets.
jen-sre: all canaries stable. Gradual traffic shifting back — observed small burst of retries but no lasting customer impact.
maria-support: updated customers with recovery note and promise of full postmortem within 72h. Some customers asked for contact for SLA claims; I created support queue #1567 for follow-up.
sam-net: thanks team. I'll document BGP session details and our remediation steps for postmortem.
jen-sre: post-incident checklist:
- collect provider logs and our route table history
- collect tcpdumps and kv cache metrics
- timeline + customer impact summary
- action items: add automated tenant fallback flagging, improve health-check granularity for privatelink DNS
maria-support: agreed. I'll own customer communication follow-through.
incident-bot: Incident declared resolved by jen-sre at 2026-03-15T15:20:00Z :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Pager closed for sam-net (oncall). Thanks.
sam-net: handing off notes into the incident board. Leaving the channel. :wave:
jen-sre: I'll keep watch for one more hour then close the thread. Good work everyone.
